diff --git a/src/ahttpx/_parsers.py b/src/ahttpx/_parsers.py
index 8a52a56..ca2241f 100644
--- a/src/ahttpx/_parsers.py
+++ b/src/ahttpx/_parsers.py
@@ -375,11 +375,14 @@ class HTTPParser:
             self.recv_state = State.DONE
         return body
 
-    async def complete(self):
+    @property
+    def keep_alive(self) -> bool:
+        return self.send_keep_alive and self.recv_keep_alive
+
+    async def reset(self):
         is_fully_complete = self.send_state == State.DONE and self.recv_state == State.DONE
-        is_keepalive = self.send_keep_alive and self.recv_keep_alive
 
-        if not (is_fully_complete and is_keepalive):
+        if not (is_fully_complete and self.keep_alive):
             await self.close()
             return
 
diff --git a/src/ahttpx/_server.py b/src/ahttpx/_server.py
index a9103cc..50671d5 100644
--- a/src/ahttpx/_server.py
+++ b/src/ahttpx/_server.py
@@ -38,6 +38,8 @@ class HTTPConnection:
                 async with Request(method, url, headers=headers, content=stream) as request:
                     try:
                         response = await self._endpoint(request)
+                        while self._parser.keep_alive and await self._recv_body():
+                            pass
                         status_line = f"{request.method} {request.url.target} [{response.status_code} {response.reason_phrase}]"
                         logger.info(status_line)
                     except Exception:
@@ -89,7 +91,7 @@ class HTTPConnection:
 
     # Start it all over again...
     async def _complete(self):
-        await self._parser.complete
+        await self._parser.reset()
         self._idle_expiry = time.monotonic() + self._keepalive_duration
 
 
@@ -122,5 +124,8 @@ async def serve_http(endpoint):
 
 
 async def run(app):
-    async with await serve_http(app) as server:
-        server.wait()
+    try:
+        async with await serve_http(app) as server:
+            await server.wait()
+    except KeyboardInterrupt:
+        pass
